event.description: Prune learned positions only at special-token slots
event.proposal: family: position representation; retained incumbent is 3584 parameters at 99.1700%, a +0.17 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: none; same-family failed result: attempt-0014, rank-8 learned-position factorization at 4136/0.11% (with attempts 0003 and 0005 also failing); prior position attempts: 4. The d14 width probe in attempt-0025 scored 9.99%, so this keeps d16 MQA and changes only position-table scope. Hypothesis: operand and answer digit columns need independent learned rows, but BOS, plus, equals, and EOS positions may rely on their distinct token embeddings; use 31 learned rows and zero position contribution at those four slots, yielding 3520 parameters. This is more informative than removing or factorizing the whole position table because every arithmetic column retains full positional capacity. Keep mixed-digit training and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3584 parameters.
